name: To Constrict and To Suffocate
source:
Maca, a curious sea creature, forms a deep connection with Lyra, a cynical human who frequents the coast. As their bond grows, Maca desires to "own" Lyra, while Lyra hides her own feelings behind sarcasm. The story focuses on conversations that Maca and Lyra have as something sweet and bitter blooms within them...

[From [url=https://peridon.itch.io/to-constrict-and-to-suffocate]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
玛卡是一种好奇的海洋生物，她与经常光顾海岸的愤世嫉俗的人类莱拉建立了深厚的联系。随着他们的关系日益加深，玛卡渴望“拥有”莱拉，而莱拉则将自己的感受隐藏在讽刺背后。故事的重点是玛卡和莱拉的对话，他们内心绽放出甜蜜和苦涩的味道……

[来自[url=https://peridon.itch.io/to-constrict-and-to-suffocate]itch.io[/url]]
